# MARKDKBERRY DOT COM NOTES

May 2026

I never had much luck with Klein until I used Allisonexdr head swap and it beat the ass off QWEN in a big way not just result but in speed. Now I have to figure out why and how.

---

# Mystery 1:

**CONCLUSION** new settings 4 steps, lcm, cfg 1, and without the speed up loras, and use the klein 9b fp8 model not the GGUF (only for speed quality is about the same).

Why does Allisonexdr headswap workflow use only 4 steps without speed up lora, cfg 1, lcm? When all mine have all had 8 steps with a speed up lora, euler, cfg 2?

**RESULT** Turns out with the klein9b_fp8 model I dont need that and 4 steps, lcm, cfg 1 work very well. did a portrait i2i in 37 seconds at 1mp. how did I not discover this before? 

testing with the GGUF Q8 model too see if it was that? got almost identical quality result but slower at 49 seconds.

---

## PROMPTS THAT WORK:

`replace the head of the man on the left in image 1 with the head of the man from image 2.`

`use the man in image 1 to create a passport photo with grey background and neutral expression.`

`use the coat the man is wearing in image 1 to create a product display photo of the coat on a grey background` 
*(include "just the coat" if you get unwanted head)*

`remove the man's head from the product photo in image 1. change nothing else.`

`replace the jacket of the man in the centre of image 1 with the jacket from image 2.`

`replace the red doors from image 1 with the black doors in image 2.`
  

**To outpaint**:

`outpaint the white area to fill out the image` , or create size canvas you want in Krita and fill the empty space with red (or a color not in the image) then take it to Klein and prompt:

`remove the red paddings on the side and show what's behind them`
